text:
Nadia: Cascade Bank POC tomorrow. They asked for a one-page connectivity acceptance + firewall snippet for PrivateDeploy. Need to confirm: connector in customer VPC, egress via their perimeter proxy, preserve client IPs, and static allowlist. Can someone draft? @Ethan @Rohit
Ethan: Ill take the checklist. Confirming two supported flows: (A) Interface endpoint (PrivateLink) for control plane + proxy for model egress, (B) VPC peering/TGW where PrivateLink is disallowed. Call out tradeoffs.
Rohit: Short firewall/egress snippet for their netsec team:
```
# outbound TLS to Redwood management and model endpoints
ALLOW tcp 443 to management.<region>.redwood-hosted.net and models.<region>.redwood-hosted.net
# DNS
ALLOW udp 53 to customer resolver or 1.1.1.1
# NTP
ALLOW udp 123 to pool.ntp.org
# If using PrivateLink: allow ENI IPs for interface endpoint (we provide list)
# If peering: allow egress to provided IP ranges/ASNs (we provide)
```
sec-bot: Security bullets for the questionnaire (short): TLS 1.2+ enforced (1.3 recommended); KMS options: customer KMS (recommended) or Redwood-managed with attestation; audit log delivery to S3/syslog, retention configurable. Operator kill switch must be auditable.
Ethan: Ops acceptance checklist (one page):
- Topology selected (PrivateLink or peering) and documented
- Interface endpoint ENI IPs OR model IP ranges whitelisted
- Connector subnet routes to proxy without SNAT (preserve src IP)
- TLS handshake validated (openssl s_client)
- tcpdump sample shows original client IP at proxy
- Smoke curl to /healthz from bastion with --resolve
- Security bullets acknowledged
infra-bot: Smoke test snippet:
```
curl -v https://api.redwood-hosted.net/healthz --resolve "api.redwood-hosted.net:443:<connector-ip>"
```
Rohit: Note for TLS-inspect setups: either enable SNI passthrough or configure mTLS between connector and proxy. If they terminate TLS and re-sign, we need cert pinning or SAN allowlist.
Nadia: Sales pricing note: include PrivateDeploy base fee + infra surcharge; stable egress IPs and reserved GPU pools -> reserved-capacity add-on. Ill add numbers in the external quote.
Ethan: Will keep to one page checklist + one page runbook. Draft in channel in ~30m.
Nadia: Thanks team :thumbsup:
